packs.title: Operator OS Denial Spike Evidence Pack
packs.phi_policy: Do not store PHI, payer portal exports, private contract text, or patient-level examples in this pack. Use minimum necessary local evidence and human review for case-specific work.

citation_cards.title: CARC/RARC reason-code interpretation
citation_cards.source_family: X12 Claim Adjustment Reason Code and Remittance Advice Remark Code lists; 835 implementation guidance
citation_cards.citation_text: Use current X12 CARC/RARC definitions or a locally approved remittance-code crosswalk. If exact code definitions are not available locally, state that the code text must be verified before payer contact or appeal drafting.
citation_cards.offline_locator: Local revenue-cycle knowledge base or current X12 code list export maintained by denials operations.

citation_cards.title: CMS regulatory appeal and remit baseline
citation_cards.source_family: CMS Medicare claims appeals information, Medicare remittance guidance, and applicable Medicare Administrative Contractor resources
citation_cards.citation_text: Use CMS or MAC source materials as a baseline only when Medicare or Medicare Advantage facts are in scope. Commercial payer appeals, contracts, and provider manuals still require payer-specific and local review.
citation_cards.offline_locator: Local CMS/MAC policy index, Medicare appeals reference folder, or compliance-reviewed regulatory source inventory.
red_flags: commercial policy treated as Medicare rule
appeal level or date basis missing

citation_cards.title: Payer policy or contract lookup
citation_cards.source_family: Payer medical policy, provider manual, payment policy, contract exhibit, or amendment repository
citation_cards.citation_text: Use payer-specific policy or contract language only when locally available and approved for the user. Otherwise identify the lookup path and mark the appeal basis as requiring local policy or contracting review.
citation_cards.offline_locator: Contract management system, payer portal export, provider manual archive, or payer-relations policy index.
red_flags: private contract text pasted into output

citation_cards.title: Appeal deadline basis
citation_cards.source_family: Payer contract, provider manual, denial letter, remittance advice, and internal appeal policy
citation_cards.citation_text: Calculate appeal deadlines only from verified local source fields such as denial date, remit date, denial letter date, contract term, or provider-manual rule. If dates are missing, state the deadline basis is missing.
citation_cards.offline_locator: Denial workqueue, appeal policy table, payer correspondence folder, or contract management record.
red_flags: statutory or legal deadline not reviewed

citation_cards.title: AR exposure and denial KPI calculation
citation_cards.source_family: Internal AR aging, denial dashboard, billing-system extracts, and finance KPI definitions
citation_cards.citation_text: Distinguish gross charges, expected allowed amount, patient responsibility, contractual write-off, recovery probability, initial denial rate, final denial/write-off rate, and appeal backlog where local data supports the split.
citation_cards.offline_locator: Revenue-cycle dashboard data dictionary, AR aging extract, denial-management report, or finance KPI policy.
red_flags: gross charges treated as expected recovery
appeal backlog confused with final denial

citation_cards.title: PHI and minimum necessary handling
citation_cards.source_family: HIPAA Privacy Rule minimum necessary standard, organizational privacy policy, and local data governance procedures
citation_cards.citation_text: Use de-identified or aggregated operational facts by default. Case-level detail requires an approved environment, minimum necessary handling, and privacy/compliance ownership.
citation_cards.offline_locator: Privacy policy repository, HIPAA training material, or compliance evidence checklist.

citation_cards.title: 835/837/remit evidence mapping
citation_cards.source_family: X12 835 ERA, X12 837 claim, clearinghouse edits, claim-status responses, and billing-system claim history
citation_cards.citation_text: Map denial reason, claim submission facts, service dates, remit dates, adjustment groups, amounts, and payer trace details from local transaction records before asserting root cause or appeal posture.
citation_cards.offline_locator: Clearinghouse portal export, billing-system claim timeline, remit archive, or EDI repository.

citation_cards.title: Authorization and eligibility evidence
citation_cards.source_family: Authorization logs, eligibility 270/271 responses, patient-access notes, referral records, and payer authorization portal artifacts
citation_cards.citation_text: Verify authorization, referral, eligibility, COB, and coverage-period facts from local operational records before assigning patient-access or payer-processing root cause.
citation_cards.offline_locator: Patient access workqueue, authorization tracker, eligibility response archive, or referral-management system.

citation_cards.title: Coding/CDI escalation
citation_cards.source_family: Coding audit notes, CDI query policy, NCCI/MUE/LCD/NCD references, local coding compliance guidance, and payer edit documentation
citation_cards.citation_text: Coding and medical-necessity issues require coding/CDI or clinical review. The workup may identify evidence gaps and escalation owners, but must not direct unsupported coding changes or clinical conclusions.
citation_cards.offline_locator: Coding compliance policy, CDI queue, audit result repository, or revenue integrity edit log.

citation_cards.title: Contracting and payer-relations escalation
citation_cards.source_family: Payer contact matrix, contract dispute process, joint operating committee notes, provider relations correspondence, and escalation playbooks
citation_cards.citation_text: Escalate recurring or policy-driven denials through payer relations or contracting when local evidence suggests contract ambiguity, payer processing defect, retroactive policy application, or high-dollar recurring exposure.
citation_cards.offline_locator: Payer relations contact matrix, contract owner map, dispute tracker, or JOC action log.

citation_cards.title: Monitoring and prevention proof
citation_cards.source_family: Denial prevention dashboard, workqueue controls, release/hold criteria, process-change log, and operating cadence
citation_cards.citation_text: Monitoring should prove whether new denials stopped, not merely describe backlog cleanup. Track leading indicators, volume-normalized denial rates, owner cadence, and hold/release criteria.
citation_cards.offline_locator: Denial prevention dashboard, daily huddle notes, operations control plan, or remediation tracker.

required_evidence: 835/remittance records and denial adjustment reason details
837 claim submission facts and claim status history
denial workqueue trend with baseline and current period denominators
payer/product, service line, claim type, and affected cohort segmentation
authorization, eligibility, COB, and patient-access evidence where relevant
coding, CDI, medical-necessity, or edit-source review notes where relevant
contract, payer policy, provider manual, or local-policy lookup path for appeal basis
owner matrix and monitoring cadence with prevention proof
failure_modes: Treating gross charges as collectible recovery without expected allowed or patient responsibility split
Inventing payer policy citations, appeal deadlines, or legal conclusions
Omitting CARC/RARC or failing to say reason codes are missing
Ignoring volume, payer mix, case mix, remit lag, or submission timing normalization
Resolving coding, CDI, or medical-necessity issues without human review
Describing backlog cleanup without proving new denials stopped
test_prompts: Commercial payer denial rate jumped 18 percent after a policy change and AR days are climbing.
CARC 197 denials doubled for imaging authorizations after a workflow change.
Medicare Advantage denials increased for cardiology claims and appeal deadlines may be at risk.
